project_info.theme: Map-style guide to activity stations at the launch event
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Soft Pink, White, Beige, Leaf Green

main_subject.detail: A pastel infographic showing four numbered activity stations in the Cocoon event space, connected by a white flowing route line, with miniature 3D stand graphics and labels for check-in, information, challenge, and verification stations.
main_subject.style: Friendly event guide infographic, pastel 3D icon map, simplified activation journey visual

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'KHÁM PHÁ CÁC TRẠM NHẬN QUÀ HẤP DẪN', '1 TRẠM CHECK-IN', '2 TRẠM THÔNG TIN', '3 TRẠM THỬ THÁCH', and '4 TRẠM KIỂM CHỨNG'.
items: Top Left: Main white headline and subheadline over a blue-to-pink gradient background.
Top Right: Stylized pink information panels labeled station 2, framed by green leaves.
Bottom Left: Verification station 4 represented by pastel display screens and podiums.
Bottom Right: Challenge station 3 with a stylized sunscreen bottle marked 'BẢO VỆ PHỔ RỘNG' and an SPF 50+ bubble.
Center/Background: White curved route line connecting the numbered stations, plus a check-in stage with two bottle icons and Cocoon branding.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft pastel gradients, clean 3D icon clarity, easy event-navigation readability

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for an event-station guide. Centerpiece is a pastel infographic map with four numbered stations connected by a white curving route line: '1 TRẠM CHECK-IN', '2 TRẠM THÔNG TIN', '3 TRẠM THỬ THÁCH', and '4 TRẠM KIỂM CHỨNG'. Background is a blue-to-pink gradient. Surrounding elements: miniature 3D-style station icons, Cocoon branding, a sunscreen bottle marked 'BẢO VỆ PHỔ RỘNG', an SPF 50+ bubble, display screens, and decorative green leaves. Keep the exact station wording and pastel event-guide look. Technical style: high fidelity vector-plus-3D infographic design, flat infographic lighting, soft pastel gradients and clear 3D icon readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
